item.title: Towards $\mathbb{A}^1$-homotopy theory of rigid analytic spaces
item.description: arXiv:2407.09606v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: To any rigid analytic space (in the sense of Fujiwara--Kato) we assign an $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant rigid analytic homotopy category with coefficients in any presentable category. We show some functorial properties of this assignment as a functor on the category of rigid analytic spaces. Moreover, we show that there exists a full six-functor formalism for the precomposition with the analytification functor by evoking Ayoub's thesis. As an application, we prove mod $p$ rigidity for rigid spaces over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. Moreover, we prove the equivalence of $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant sheaves and $\mathbb{B}^1$-invariant sheaves in the mod $\ell$ case.
item.dc:creator: Christian Dahlhausen, Can Yaylali

item.title: Higher Lefschetz formulas on {\Gamma}-proper manifolds
item.description: arXiv:2512.14318v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Let $\Gamma$ be a finitely generated discrete group acting properly and cocompactly on a smooth manifold M. By employing heat-kernel techniques we prove a geometric formula for the pairing of the index class associated to a $\Gamma$-equivariant Dirac operator $D$ with a delocalized cyclic cocycles $\tau$ in $HP^\bullet (\mathbb{C}\Gamma,\langle \gamma \rangle)$. Our formula takes place on the fixed point manifold $M^\gamma$ and should be regarded as a higher Lefschetz formula for $D$. The formula involves the Atiyah-Segal-Singer form and an explicit $Z_\gamma$-invariant form on $M^\gamma$ that is naturally associated to $\tau\in HP^\bullet (\mathbb{C}\Gamma,\langle \gamma \rangle)$
item.dc:creator: Paolo Piazza, Hessel Posthuma, Yanli Song, Xiang Tang
